parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['product_name','current_pricing'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const plans=Array.isArray(body.current_pricing)?body.current_pricing:[];if(plans.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'current_pricing must be a non-empty array of plan objects'}}];return[{json:{valid:true,productName:body.product_name.trim(),productDescription:(body.product_description||'').slice(0,400),currentPricing:plans.slice(0,6).map(p=>({name:(p.name||'Plan').trim(),price:parseFloat(p.price)||0,currency:p.currency||'USD',interval:p.interval||'month',features:Array.isArray(p.features)?p.features:(p.features||'').split(',').map(f=>f.trim()).filter(Boolean),highlighted:p.highlighted===true||p.highlighted==='true'})),targetAudience:(body.target_audience||'').slice(0,300),currentConversionRate:parseFloat(body.current_conversion_rate)||null,avgRevenuePerUser:parseFloat(body.avg_revenue_per_user)||null,mainConversionGoal:body.main_conversion_goal||'free_to_paid',pricingProblems:(body.pricing_problems||'').slice(0,500),competitorPricing:(body.competitor_pricing||'').slice(0,400),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You advise SaaS companies on pricing page A/B tests. You understand pricing psychology (anchoring, decoy pricing, value communication), conversion optimization, and how to design statistically valid tests. You give specific, testable hypotheses — not generic advice. Always respond in valid JSON only.
